To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the perception of the linguistic functions of prosody is based on a hierarchical structure, the perception of the segmentation / hierarchical function is based on a combination of the acoustic parameters F0, syllable duration, syllabic intensity and the perception of the emphasis function is based on the acoustic parameters F 0 and syllable duration.
the perception of a reiterant speech paradigm is a good functional diagnostic of synthetic prosody.
the prosodic parameters of intensity, syllable duration and fundamental frequency are all important to the listener when judging the adequacy of the synthetic prosody to the linguistic function.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues : (a) the use of reiterant speech in a perception experiment, (b) the acoustic parameters used to describe the prosody of reiterant stimuli, (c) the use of several measures to compare listeners’ judgements with the acoustic parameters of stimuli, and (d) the use of the results to carry out a functional diagnostic of prosody.
the following question : “How do the listeners use prosody to perform the segmentation / hierachisation function?”.
the following questions : (1) What are the acoustic keys used to perceive the adequacy of a given prosodic structure to perform a given prosodic function?;
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the prosodic parameter of F0 is more relevant than the syllabic duration and the intensity in the perception of the reiterant speech paradigm.

(i) listeners use F0 and intensity as the main parameters in the segmentation / hierar-chisation function of prosody; (ii) the duration parameter is not used to perform the segmentation / hier-archisation linguistic function.

the perception of the linguistic function of prosodic segmentation is based on the acoustic parameters of F0 and syllabic duration, whereas the perception of the hierarchisation function is mainly based on F0.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the listeners’ judgments are not related to a unique acoustic parameter.
a listener’s judgement of the adequacy of the prosodic parameters is not based on a single parameter, but on a combination of several of them.
, in a synthetic speech, F0 is the parameter which has the most impact on the perception of the adequacy of a given prosody.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the listeners use a set of prosodic parameters to perform the segmentation / hierachisation linguistic function of synthetic speech.
the perception of the linguistic function of prosodic parameters is not only based on the global acoustic values of these parameters, but also on their relative values.

the perception of the prosodic parameters used to perform the linguistic functions of hierarchisation and segmentation is very similar, even though the linguistic function of each of these parameters is different.
